snippet.title: Cannon Super Mario Bros Wii. Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Its time for a new hack called Cannon Super Mario Bros. Wii. A hack made by Leplap and Weland, its made for multi and singleplayer and features many custom objects, custom music and much more. So are you ready for some fun cause here we go!

Cannon Super Mario Bros .Wii features:

- 14 full new levels divided over 3 worlds
- Over 50 new goodies and retextured objects
- Many custom music composed over almost all levels
- And of course some custom tilesets

You can find the download link over here:
http://rvlution.net/forums/viewtopic.php?f=20&t=1080

Feedback appreciated! Subscribe for more.
